bugs.title: Holidays page keeps showing every brand after picking one in the header dropdown
bugs.root_cause: HolidayClient copied its initial prop into state (useState(initial)); the brand dropdown only changes ?brand=, so React kept the old client state from the All brands view.
bugs.fix_summary: Key HolidayClient by the chosen brand so it remounts with fresh state when the brand changes.

bugs.title: dev-api build fails: new module missing from the zip file list (Bluesky)
bugs.root_cause: index.mjs imports bluesky-connect.mjs (PR #248) but the build workflow zip and syntax-check lists omit it; the build's load check fails, so no deployable zip.
bugs.fix_summary: Added the module to the workflow lists and a test that every module index.mjs reaches is in both zip lists (workflow and package.json).

bugs.title: No "Disconnect successful" confirmation next to the button
bugs.root_cause: ConnectionDisconnect navigated straight to the page; only the LinkedIn section had an anchor id.
bugs.fix_summary: Show a success notice for ~1.8 s, then reload onto the network's own section; added anchors for the other six networks.

bugs.title: Disconnect button failed with HTTP 404 (then 500) on every network
bugs.root_cause: API Gateway had no POST /connections/disconnect route; once added, the dev-api Lambda resource policy had no per-route invoke permission for it.
bugs.fix_summary: Created route aqvtww7 -> integration h25cb92, then Dean added Lambda permission statement disconnect-route. Keyless smoke test now returns 401.
